mapper.select: SELECT `t1`.`item_id` AS `itemId`, `t3`.`item_name` AS `itemName`, `t1`.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, `t1`.`size` AS `size` , `t1`.`price` AS `price`, `t2`.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, (SELECT `img`.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` AS `img` WHERE `img`.`product_id` = `t3`.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `imagePath` FROM `cors`.`order_items` AS `t1` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`orders` AS `t2` ON `t1`.order_id = `t2`.id LEFT JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` AS `t3` ON `t1`.`item_id` = `t3`.`id` WHERE `t2`.`user_email` = #{userEmail} ORDER BY `createdAt`
